title: Tinder Experiment: 18 Yr Old Woman Tries Being A Man!!!
summary: A social experiment in which an 18-year-old woman runs a Tinder profile as a man and sees how differently the dating experience plays out for men.
why: HN brings it up in dating app threads as a real-world illustration of how hard Tinder is for men.

quote.text: I loved the Youtube video where a woman tries to impersonate a man and get a date with women on a dating app.
